content:
olivia_tm: Need advice  manager has verbal okay to promote an IC from Eng II -> Eng III with a $12k base bump and a one-time retention bonus. Director approves. Candidate has a live counteroffer and wants effective 2025-07-01. What steps to make this fast and clean?

lina_hr: Congrats. Fast path checklist: 1) complete Role Change packet in HR portal and mark "expedite" in comments, 2) attach director approval + counteroffer evidence, 3) submit Compensation Adjustment for the one-time bonus and link both requests, 4) notify Finance for budget code confirmation.

marcus_comp: If you want expedited comp review, include market data (salary bands or levels) and a short justification (3 bullets). For retention bonus, state desired pay period (e.g., "pay period 2025-07") and amount. We triage expedited requests within 3 business days but no SLA for approvals.

olivia_tm: FYI manager prefers no retro. How do we guarantee payroll processes base change as of 7/1 without backpay?

michael_payroll: To avoid retro, final approved packet must be in payroll inbox by 2025-06-18 EOD for a 2025-07-01 effective date. If Comp or Finance approval delays us past 6/18, we'll still process but payroll will compute retro from 7/1 once approvals arrive. For retention bonus, include preferred pay period and employee ID.

elaine_legal: Quick legal note for retention: include language in the retention approval doc clarifying tax withholding and clawback terms if applicable. For international employees we need local counsel signoff.

lina_hr: Two extra things: 1) if bump moves them above the top of current band we need Comp panel signoff; mark in packet "salary above band cap" if so. 2) If this promotion will change equity grant eligibility (expedite grant), submit Equity Recommendation form at same time.

marcus_comp: Also confirm whether this is a title-only vs band+salary move. Band jumps >1 always need panel. If it's within band but salary exceeds midpoint we can approve faster with director + comp signoff attached.

olivia_tm: Manager says band stays same, bump is within upper quartile but under cap. We'll attach director email + market comps. One more: do we put the retention bonus on same ticket or separate?

lina_hr: Submit both but link them in the portal comments and in the Compensation Adjustment reference. Payroll prefers one combined package so the base change and one-time go in the same payroll note: "apply one-time retention in pay period 2025-07; base adjust 2025-07-01".

michael_payroll: If combined, include this exact comment and employee ID. That avoids double taxation or duplicate payments.

olivia_tm: Great. I'll assemble Role Change + Comp Adj + Equity (maybe) tonight and ping when submitted. Any suggested subject line for emails?

marcus_comp: Subject: "Expedite: Role Change + Retention | [EmployeeName] | Eff 2025-07-01" and attach director approval and counteroffer PDF. That helps our inbox routing.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Required Role Change fields: employee name, employee ID, current title, new title, proposed base, effective date, manager rationale (3 bullets), director approval, budget code. Portal: https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change. Payroll deadlines: https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines.
